blocks.tamil_translation: says, “The second man (said), “O Allah! My paternal uncle had a daughter. She was very dear to me. I (once) wanted to fulfil my desire with her. But she did not agree to it. Meanwhile, because of poverty, she was forced to come (to me). “I gave her one hundred and twenty gold coins on the condition that she meet me in private, and she agreed to it. In the end (when I had got the right opportunity to fulfil my desire) she said, “I do not consider it lawful for you to break this seal wrongfully.” (On hearing this) I gave up my evil intention, and although she was truly very dear to me, I moved away from her. I also left her the gold coins I had given her. O Allah! If I did this deed for Your pleasure, remove this hardship of ours!” he made Du'a, and so the rock moved aside a little more, but still they could not come out. The third (said), “O Allah, I had hired some labourers. I paid all of them their wages. Only one man went away without taking his wage. I invested his wage money in trade. In the end his wealth grew, and after some days he came one day and said, “O servant of Allah! Give me my wage.” To this I said, “These camels, cattle, goats and slaves that you see — all of these are your wage money!”. These profits came because your wage money was invested in trade,” I said. He said, “O servant of Allah! Do not mock me”, (and) I said, “I am not mocking” (I am telling the truth). (At my explanation)
